meta.name: feishu-bridge
meta.description: Connect a Feishu (Lark) bot to Clawdbot via WebSocket long-connection. No public server, domain, or ngrok required. Use when setting up Feishu/Lark as a messaging channel, troubleshooting the Feishu bridge, or managing the bridge service (start/stop/logs). Covers bot creation on Feishu Open Platform, credential setup, bridge startup, macOS launchd auto-restart, and group chat behavior tuning.

copy.tagline: 将飞书机器人接入 Clawdbot 实现消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在飞书中使用 Clawdbot 进行消息收发。
copy.tagline_en: Connect Feishu bot to Clawdbot for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Clawdbot within Feishu for messaging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过本地 WebSocket 连接飞书机器人，接收和回复飞书消息，无需公网服务器。
howto.when: 当你在飞书开放平台创建好机器人应用，并配置好凭证和事件后，运行桥接脚本即可启用。

say.text: 帮我设置飞书机器人，连接我的 Clawdbot。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to a Feishu bot via local WebSocket to receive and reply to messages without a public server.
howto.when_en: When you have created a bot app on Feishu Open Platform, configured credentials and events, then run the bridge script.

say_en.text: Help me set up the Feishu bot to connect to my Clawdbot.
